# Site content tree from internal links

When mimicking a site, **navigation, footer, and link-list components** contain hrefs to routes that may not have been fully captured or built. Those paths still define the **Sitecore content tree** that must exist so links resolve to real items (even as empty stub pages).

**Artifact:** `design-screenshots/{project}/site-content-tree.json` — generated by [`write-site-content-tree.mjs`](../../mimic-website-skills/url-screenshots/scripts/write-site-content-tree.mjs).

---

## When to run

| Phase | Action |
|-------|--------|
| After url-screenshots capture + section HTML | Run `write-site-content-tree.mjs` |
| Before Phase 4f (assemble pages) | Read `site-content-tree.json`; create YAML for **every** page entry |
| After adding nav/footer components | Re-run to pick up new internal links |

```bash
node .cursor/skills/mimic-website-skills/url-screenshots/scripts/write-site-content-tree.mjs \
  --project "./design-screenshots/{domain}" \
  --site-content-path "/sitecore/content/{collection}/{sitename}"
```

---

## Link harvest sources (priority)

1. `sections/header/section.html`
2. `sections/navigation/section.html`
3. `sections/footer/section.html`
4. `sections/breadcrumb/section.html`
5. Link-list sections from `sections/manifest.json`
6. Every captured `{page-slug}/page.html`

**Include:** same-origin `href` values pointing to HTML pages.

**Exclude:** `mailto:`, `tel:`, `javascript:`, `#`, external domains, file downloads (`.pdf`, `.jpg`, …).

---

## Route → Sitecore mapping

Same rules as [page-decomposition.md](page-decomposition.md#page-content-tree):

| Reference URL path | YAML file | Sitecore `Path` |
|--------------------|-----------|-----------------|
| `/` or `/en` (language root) | `{siteContentPath}/Home.yml` | `…/Home` |
| `/en/calendar` | `{siteContentPath}/Home/Calendar.yml` | `…/Home/Calendar` |
| `/en/calendar/hlth-2026` | `{siteContentPath}/Home/Calendar/Hlth 2026.yml` | `…/Home/Calendar/Hlth 2026` |

**Rules:**

1. Strip language prefix (`/en`, `/nl`) before mapping segments.
2. Convert URL segments to item names — title case with spaces (`about-us` → `About Us`).
3. Nest all pages under **`Home`** — never as siblings of `Home` at site root.
4. Homepage renderings stay on **`Home.yml`** — never `Home/Home.yml`.

---

## Page status in `site-content-tree.json`

| `status` | Meaning | YAML |
|----------|---------|------|
| `mimicked` | Full page capture exists (`page-manifest.json` + components) | `__Renderings` with section components |
| `stub` | Link-only — no capture or components yet | Page item with `Title` / `NavigationTitle` only — **no** `__Renderings` (or empty layout device) |

**Stub pages are required** so Navigation/Footer General Link fields can target real content items. A stub page still renders (header/footer via page design) — main column is empty until components are added later.

---

## Authoring script workflow

Reference implementation: `authoring/scripts/Complete-RaiAuthoring.mjs` → `writeStubPagesFromTree()` reads `design-screenshots/{project}/site-content-tree.json`.

After `site-content-tree.json` exists:

```
1. Load tree.pages[]
2. For each page (sorted by depth — parents before children):
   a. Ensure parent chain YAML exists (create stub parents if needed)
   b. If status === 'mimicked' → write full page YAML (existing workflow)
   c. If status === 'stub' → write stub page YAML:
      - Template: site Page template (same as mimicked pages)
      - Fields: Title, NavigationTitle from tree.title
      - Omit __Renderings OR empty <d> device block
      - stableGuid(`{project}-page-{sitecorePath}`) for deterministic IDs
3. When writing Navigation/Footer/LinkList datasource links (**required**):
   a. Load `site-content-tree.json` **before** datasource YAML (same stable GUID map as stub pages)
   b. For each General Link href: if route exists in tree → **`linktype="internal"`** with item `id` + content `url`
   c. Only use `linktype="external"` when route is **not** in tree (social, third-party, `#`, mailto)
   d. Never point same-origin nav/footer links at production `https://reference-site.com/...` when a tree item exists
```

**Authoring helper pattern** (`linkField(text, href)` in `Complete-*Authoring.mjs`):

1. `loadContentTreeLinks()` at script start — builds route → `{ id, linkUrl }` index with same IDs as stub/mimicked pages
2. `resolveInternalLink(href)` — match pathname / language-stripped route against tree
3. Emit internal XML when matched; external otherwise

```javascript
function linkField(text, href) {
  const internal = resolveInternalLink(href);
  if (internal) {
    return `<link class="" id="${internal.id}" querystring="" anchor="" target="" title="" linktype="internal" text="${text}" url="${internal.linkUrl}" />`;
  }
  // external fallback for social, #, off-site
}
```

### Stub page YAML pattern

```yaml
ID: "{stable-guid}"
Parent: "{parent-item-id}"
Template: "{PAGE_TEMPLATE_ID}"
Path: "{siteContentPath}/Home/Organising"
Languages:
- Language: en
  Versions:
  - Version: 1
    Fields:
    - ID: "{NAV_TITLE_FIELD}"
      Hint: NavigationTitle
      Value: Organise your event
    - ID: "{PAGE_TITLE_FIELD}"
      Hint: Title
      Value: Organise your event
```

**Do not** set per-page `Page Design` field — use site-wide `TemplatesMapping` on `Presentation/Page Designs.yml`.

### Internal General Link (**required** when page exists in tree)

```xml
<link class="" id="{PAGE_ITEM_ID}" querystring="" anchor="" target="" title="" linktype="internal" text="Calendar" url="/rai/rai-amsterdam/Home/Calendar" />
```

- `id` — item GUID from `site-content-tree.json` / `stableGuid('…-page-{sitecorePath}')` (must match page YAML `ID`)
- `url` — content path with `/sitecore/content` stripped (matches forma-lux / headless pattern)
- `text` — link label from capture (`sources[].text`)

**Rule:** if `resolveInternalLink(href)` finds a tree entry, **always** emit `linktype="internal"`. External is only for off-site, `#`, `mailto:`, or routes not in the tree.

---

## Intermediate folder segments

When `/about-us/our-strategy` requires `Home/About Us/` before `Our Strategy`:

| Depth | If child exists | YAML |
|-------|-----------------|------|
| `/about-us` only | leaf page | `Home/About Us.yml` (page) |
| `/about-us` + `/about-us/team` | parent + child | `Home/About Us.yml` may be page **or** folder-like page with optional content; `Home/About Us/Team.yml` child |

**Headless SXA pattern:** use the **same Page template** for intermediate nodes unless the site module defines a dedicated folder template. Parent page can be stub with children nested underneath.

**Parent chain:** when a stub route is nested (e.g. `/news/article-title`), ensure intermediate segment items exist (`Home/News.yml`) before the leaf — authoring scripts must create parents recursively (`ensureStubChain` in `Complete-RaiAuthoring.mjs`).

---

## Verification

- [ ] `site-content-tree.json` generated after capture
- [ ] Every internal href from header/footer/nav appears in `tree.pages`
- [ ] YAML exists for every `tree.pages[]` entry (mimicked + stub)
- [ ] Parent IDs chain correctly under `Home`
- [ ] Navigation/Footer links resolve in editing host (no 404 for linked routes)
- [ ] Same-origin General Link fields use `linktype="internal"` + item `id` when route exists in `site-content-tree.json`
- [ ] Mimicked pages unchanged — stubs do not overwrite full `__Renderings`

---

## Do not

- Create pages only for URLs explicitly captured — **also** create stub pages for nav/footer links
- Point all links at production `https://reference-site.com/...` when mimicked page items exist in `site-content-tree.json` — use `linktype="internal"` instead
- Create `Home/Home.yml` for the homepage
- Skip re-running tree generation after footer/nav TSX changes link fields
